latest.text: Thanks, glad Jellyfin and Jellyseerr are working well for you! Search in Discover is already there: press △ on the Discover tab and it searches everything on your Seerr server, not just the recommendations. The server address should be saved: once you’ve signed in, Emby5 keeps your server and account in /data/Emby5/config/ and signs you straight back in the next time it starts. If you’re having to type it in on every launch, something is stopping it from saving. Could you open an issue at so I…
